text: Luca Iversen wins the ball with a tackle in his own half, near the left flank. He plays a long forward pass to Mason Morales on the right wing, who delivers a low cross into the penalty area. Iversen moves in to the near post, about 3 metres from the goal at Westport Albion’s end, and shoots with his foot. The ball goes in, tying the match 3-3 in the 82nd minute [#1512] [#1513] [#1514] [#1515] [#1516].
